title: S3ql: pyasn1 has quadratic-time denial of service in constructed string and indefinite-length ANY decoding…
description: A denial of service vulnerability exists in pyasn1 versions 0.6.4 and earlier used by s3ql, where decoding constructed OCTET STRING or character strings with many fragments causes quadratic CPU time consumption due to inefficient string concatenation. This affects BER and CER decoding paths and can be triggered by attacker-supplied ASN.1 input, leading to CPU exhaustion without confidentiality or integrity impact. The issue is fixed in s3ql version 3.8.1.
